# 04-hardware

Safety-chain hardware: requirements, electrical and safety-chain design, failure analysis, reliability data and PL calculation, electrical safety, component qualification, mechanical and stability analysis.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §6 and Annexes C–F, ISO 13849-2 Annexes A–D, EN 60204-1 §5–§13 and §18, IEC 61496, IEC 60812, ASPICE HWE.1–4.
